why: The card's "religious origin of yoga = Hinduism" is contested: yoga grew up in Vedic, Jain and Buddhist circles alike. The bank asks the settled etymology instead (yuj = "to yoke"). The notes accept "to join/unite/harness" too, and the body says yoga is practised in all three traditions.

answer: General mental ability (in the classic meta-analyses)
why: Schmidt & Hunter (1998) ranked GMA first. Sackett et al. (2022, J Appl Psych 107:2040) cut its validity to about .31 and put structured interviews (about .42) first. The bank wording names the classic meta-analyses, and the body and notes already give the 2022 revision.
